data.title: 新垣绫濑 · 卧室单人床上的深情交托
data.description: 千叶清幽的住宅内，绫濑整洁的私密卧室被柔和的床头灯染上一层温馨光晕。绫濑身穿一袭素雅的淡紫色真丝吊带睡裙坐在床榻边缘，深紫色的柔顺长发整齐垂落在光滑的后背与香肩上。平日里有些偏执和严苛的完美美少女，此刻双手交扣放在身前，眼眶泛起感动的晶莹泪花，双颊绯红地轻启朱唇，诉说着全心全意的爱意。
data.location: pristine white and pastel decorated girl bedroom
data.action: sitting on edge of bed in lilac silk camisole slip dress, long dark hair over bare shoulders, hands clasped, tears of touched emotion shining in eyes, heavy blush, tender vulnerable confession
data.lighting: warm gentle bedside lamp casting serene shadows on tidy bedroom
data.mood: deep emotional devotion, yandere-softened sincerity and pure love
data.promptProse: Sitting on the edge of her bed in a soft lilac silk camisole, Ayase Aragaki gazes forward with tears of deep affection in her eyes. Her dark hair cascades over bare shoulders as she confesses her wholehearted devotion.
data.animaCaption: Ayase sitting on her bed in a lilac camisole, tears of affection shining in her eyes.
